what: The Gumroad Discover page meta description states the platform hosts over 1.6 million free and premium digital products across education, tech, design, and other categories.
verbatim_snippet: "Browse over 1.6 million free and premium digital products in education, tech, design, and more categories from Gumroad creators and online entrepreneurs."
notes: Gumroad Discover page is JS-rendered and returns only page title on direct fetch. Meta description recovered via search engine index of this exact URL. The same meta description appears across multiple Gumroad category pages, suggesting a site-wide default.
